input: Buy noise-canceling earplugs for the open-plan office

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Earplugs vs. in-ear earbuds vs. over-ear headphones all solve the problem differently; knowing whether music/calls are needed changes the product category entirely.
Budget determines whether this is a sub-$20 foam solution, a mid-range option, or a premium ANC product like Loop or Bose Sleepbuds.
Buying for one person or a team changes quantity, sizing considerations, and whether bulk/corporate purchasing matters.
Whether the user needs to stay aurally aware of colleagues (e.g., hear their name called) affects how much noise reduction is appropriate — full seal vs. partial attenuation.
Comfort priorities (e.g., all-day wear, wearing with glasses, reusable vs. disposable) narrow down shape and material significantly.
Whether they want to buy online, in-store, or need same-day availability changes where to direct them and how quickly this can be resolved.
The primary problem to solve — focus/deep work, blocking loud talkers, reducing general hum — determines the required Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) and feature set.

gold.taskTitle: Buy noise-canceling earplugs for open-plan office
gold.taskDescription: Research and purchase a suitable pair of noise-canceling earplugs to use in a noisy open-plan office environment.

questions.title: Do you also need to hear music or take calls?
questions.description: Determines whether the solution is passive earplugs only, or active earbuds with ANC and audio playback/microphone capability.

questions.title: What is your budget for this purchase?
questions.description: Establishes the price range, guiding recommendations from disposable foam earplugs all the way up to premium ANC earbuds.

questions.title: Are you buying just for yourself or for others too?
questions.description: Determines whether this is a single personal purchase or a bulk/team order, which affects sourcing and cost-per-unit considerations.

questions.title: Do you need to still hear colleagues or announcements?
questions.description: Decides the appropriate level of noise attenuation — full acoustic seal for deep focus vs. partial filtering that preserves situational awareness.

questions.title: How long will you wear them in a single stretch?
questions.description: All-day wear demands different ergonomics and materials (soft silicone, low-pressure fit) compared to short focused-work sessions.

questions.title: Do you need them today or is delivery fine?
questions.description: Determines whether to direct toward same-day in-store options (pharmacy, electronics store) or online retailers with broader selection.

questions.title: What is the main noise problem you are solving?
questions.description: Identifies the dominant distraction — loud conversations, keyboard clatter, HVAC hum, open-space echo — which sets the required Noise Reduction Rating and product category.
